tpms.when: 2017 Giulia (sensors in the wheels; no reset button or menu)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Drive normally. The system picks up the new pressures by itself, which can take up to about 20 minutes above 15 mph.
Once all tires read at or above the sticker pressure, the tire light turns off on its own.
tpms.note: If the tire light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system itself has a fault and may not warn you of low pressure. Setting the pressures will not clear it; have the system checked.
